messages:
maria: Nebula wants a preflight packet: RBAC simulation, signed audit export, KMS envelope proof, and a CVE summary. Can we scope this?

ingrid: Proposed scope: run a temp RBAC change in nebula-stg, collect audit events, produce HSM-signed manifest, export KMS rotation records, and provide CVE matrix for affected libs. I can draft runbook.

james: For non-repudiable signing they asked HSM-based. We can sign with proof_key using RSA-PSS. Example: ./tools/logchain collect --tenant nebula-stg --out /tmp/audit.jsonl && ./tools/logchain sign --in /tmp/audit.jsonl --key /opt/hsm/proof_key --out /tmp/audit.sig

oliver: Use temp_rollout feature to auto-rollback after 30m; snapshot role bindings first with rbacctl snapshot --tenant nebula-stg --out pre.json. Include actor_id and change_reason in events.

maria: Add a small verify guide for customer: ./tools/logchain verify --in audit.jsonl --sig audit.sig --pub /opt/hsm/pub/proof_key.pem and jq filters to find actor evidence.

devin: (devinfra) Confirmed: proof_key is non-exportable, rotation quarterly, signing limited to sec:signer via KMS proxy. Rotation logs stored to SIEM and /var/log/hsm/rotations.log; we can snapshot entries.

sec-bot: Ticket IS-4210 created: "Nebula preflight - RBAC sim + signed audit" assigned to ingrid, due 2026-04-02.

maria: Thanks team. Deliverables: signed manifest, audit export (actor fields), rbac rollback plan, KMS rotation slice, CVE matrix. We'll demo verify live on the call.
